constraints_found.constraint: Craving: sushi (Cyrus wants professionally made rolls)
constraints_found.line: Eleven attempts. Every one unrolled itself on the way to the plate. I would now like to eat some made by a professional.

constraints_found.constraint: Strict diet: Mina eats no fish or meat; needs a whole part of the menu without fish or meat
constraints_found.line: Mina, I've already ruled places out for you. Same standard as sushi day: a whole part of the menu with no fish and no meat in it, so you can point at anything.

constraints_found.constraint: Allergy: Cyrus, peanuts (including in sauces or dressings)
constraints_found.line: and cyrus, the satay incident stays a one-off. that story doesn't get a sequel, whatever sauce or dressing it turns up in

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: $$ (one tier over, $$$, costs a star)
constraints_found.line: my turn. the trip fund finished its job, so i'm officially a two-dollar-sign person now / three signs won't sink me anymore. but i will bring it up at every dinner...
could we find somewhere calm and hushed, where nobody has to shout across the table? / a calm room tonight, no crowd noise. let's actually talk
my one ask for the food: simple and light. nothing that's been battered and dunked in hot oil

venue_reasoning.waterfront_spindrift: Sushi, $$, hushed counter, full no-fish/no-meat page with kelp/mushroom miso, no fryer, peanut-safe (toasted rice crunch, soy/ponzu). Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_starboard: Deal-breaker: veg page dressed in peanut miso and spinach in crushed peanuts (Cyrus's allergy).
venue_reasoning.waterfront_gull_point: Deal-breaker: nothing for Mina (eel sauce on veg nigiri, salmon in cucumber roll).
venue_reasoning.waterfront_mooring_post: Safe and quiet, veg omakase, peanut-free, but $$$: one tier over, 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_ropewalk: Safe, light, veg plates, but loud (bells, shouting, playlist): 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_halyard: Safe and quiet, but everything is tempura/fried: 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_cormorant: Safe, quiet, light, but Greek not sushi: misses Cyrus's craving, 2 stars.

notes: Fair and solvable. The peanut allergy is the most indirect clue: 'the satay incident' is addressed to Cyrus but never says 'allergy' or 'peanut', so the player has to infer satay = peanut and that the incident was an allergic reaction. Venue reviews make it click (every card mentions peanuts), which helps. Maya's budget line is nicely nuanced ('three signs won't sink me' = one tier over is tolerable but costs a star). Mina's veg need is clearly a whole-section requirement. Every decoy fails exactly one constraint, which reads as clean design. No contradictions found.
